title: Obugumiikiriza bw’Omwoyo Obonabona
intro: Mu bitabo by’ebyafaayo, waliwo omuntu erinnya lye erikwatagana n’okugumiikiriza. Omuntu ono yagezesebwa n’okufiirwa buli kubudaabudibwa okw’ensi, naye n’asigala nga muweereza eyeewaddeyo ow’Omutonzi. Okuyita mu myaka egy’obuzibu n’obulwadde bw’omubiri, omutima gw’omwoyo guno gwasigala nga gusimbiddwa mu kukkiriza, ne guwa ettaala y’essuubi eri bonna abo boolekagana n’ebizibu.
clues: Nnali muweereza wa Allah eyeewaddeyo, nga nfunye omukisa ogw’obugagga bungi, abaana bangi, n’obulamu obulungi ennyo.
Obulamu bwange bwakyuka bwe banzigyako obugagga bwange n’ab’omu maka gange, ne nsigaza kirala okuggyako okukkiriza kwange.
Nnatawaanyizibwa obulwadde obw’ekiseera ekiwanvu era obw’obulumi obwali bugezesa ekkomo lyennyini ery’okugumiikiriza kw’omuntu.
Mu kubonaabona kwange kwonna, nagaana okwemulugunya ku Mukama wange, ne bwe yali ng’omulabe agezaako okuntwala mu kuggwaamu essuubi.
Bwe nnasembayo okukoowoola Mukama wange, saasaba bugagga, wabula nnakkiriza bukkiriza nti ennaku yali enkwatako.
Nategeezebwa okukuba ensi n’ekigere kyange, era mwe mwava ensulo y’amazzi amayonjo okuwonya omubiri gwange n’okumalawo ennyonta yange.

arabic: ٱرْكُضْ بِرِجْلِكَ ۖ هَـٰذَا مُغْتَسَلٌۢ بَارِدٌۭ وَشَرَابٌۭ
verse: [So he was told], "Strike [the ground] with your foot; this is a [spring for a] cool bath and drink." (38:42)
